sources.entry: The Blockstack Browser - Blockstack is an internet for decentralized apps where users own their data. The Blockstack Browser allows you to explore the Blockstack internet.

summary.one_liner: The Blockstack Browser is a deprecated Electron-style desktop and web browser for exploring the Blockstack decentralized internet, built with React and Webpack.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a browser for the Blockstack "internet" of decentralized apps where users own their data. It can be run as a macOS app, a Windows MSI installer, a Linux .deb package, or a web build via npm. Developers can run it in a development mode with BrowserSync serving on port 3000, with assets rebuilt on change. It also describes a Docker-based regtest test environment that bundles a Blockstack API node, the browser, and a CORS proxy for app developers. Logging goes to macOS unified logging on Mac and uses log4js elsewhere. The README notes the project has been deprecated in favor of the Blockstack App and receives only critical updates.
use_cases: sign in to decentralized apps with a Blockstack ID
test Blockstack apps against a regtest environment
build a macOS, Windows, Linux or web version of the browser
debug Blockstack browser issues using system logs
how_to_run: Install and start the latest Blockstack for Mac release, then enable Development Mode from the menu bar option-click
For Windows: npm run win32 (requires Wix Toolset 3.11.1 and Visual Studio 2017)
notable: Deprecated in favor of the Blockstack App; only critical updates going forward
Docker regtest test environment for app developers with no real money involved
Builds for macOS, Windows (MSI), Linux (.deb) and the web from one codebase
macOS logging integrated with unified logging and Console.app
caveats: Deprecated; only critical updates will be released by Blockstack PBC
macOS build instructions were only tested on macOS High Sierra 10.13
Docker test environment image targets AMD64 architecture
Windows build requires Visual Studio 2017 and Wix Toolset 3.11.1
